text:
I very unhappy with the botox that I received in my forehead as it caused me to have eyebrow droop. He did not assess the anatomy of my face properly so the dose he gave me was too high and injected too low. I presumed he knew what he was doing.

He given too high a dose and that it should have been injected higher up. My whole forehead is frozen, I can not lift my eyebrows at all, therefore he could not do a corrective treatment as it would not work or could end up worse. I was glad to have found someone who was honest and explained everything with great detail.

I now have to wait until the botox wears off for it to be resolved. I have had lots of headaches since and it has caused me a lot of stress. I contacted the clinic after and they said i could claim it but eventually they can't do anything about it. I have to massage my forehead and put the hot pack on my forehead everyday. Plus my face is skinny i have to go to another clinic to add more fillers.
